text:
جیٹھ تائے، تے ہاڑ وسائے،
اوس ملکھ دے کال کیوں نیڑے جائے۔
romanized:
Jéth tae, te Har vasae,
Os mulkh de kal kiu néré jae.
literal_en: If Jeth be hot and Har rainy, why should famine go near that country
meaning_en: i.e., the crop will be good.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
